notes.title: Version 2.1.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.7] Patch Notes
-Added new block "framed square"
-Minor improvement to graphic and text appearance
-Fixed blocks continuing to populate if exiting to main menu while board is being created
-Fixed blocks getting stuck on screen when restarting the game quickly
-Fixed blocks populating in a rotated state when restarting the board mid-update
-Fixed GameOver pop-up text not updating color in Light mode
-Fixed framerate when vsync is turned off

notes.title: Version 2.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.6] Patch Notes
-Added swap duration, drop duration, and selection fade settings
-Increased default swap and drop speeds slightly
-Fixed issues with various resolutions in windowed mode
-Fixed hint button to be properly disabled when it should be
-Fixed blocks persisting when resetting in certain cases

notes.title: Shapes Update!
notes.content:
[2.1.5] Patch Notes
-Added 5 new block shapes (Triangle, Pentagon, Hexagon, Heptagon, Circle)
-Improved first-time play accessibility configuration
-Fixed 7-8x8 mode 7th block type not working
-Fixed level 1+ block shape theme not saving
-Fixed color mode option not checked on startup
-Fixed music volume settings not working

notes.title: Version 2.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[2.1.4] Patch Notes
-Fixed issues with ultrawide screens
-Fixed goal block not updating correctly
-Fixed goal block being incorrectly selectable
